methods.hierarchy: Strict full-edge containment, smallest containing loop is parent; depth is not a tissue label.
methods.orientation: Compare each loop edge against plane-normal cross original face-normal. Report signed area only if all nonzero edge signs agree.
methods.topology: Original vertex indices, no welding/healing; edge incidence and orientation, component face counts. Self-intersections not tested.
methods.winding: Oriented solid-angle sum / 4pi at an explicitly non-anatomical probe; diagnostic, never a solid/void certificate.
methods.continuity: 21 Z sections 28–32 nominal mm, step 0.2mm per side. Shared original bone triangle IDs in consecutive enclosing loops. Discrete samples cannot certify a full tunnel.

limits: No bone/nerve/vessel moved or relabelled. Neither a nested loop nor closed consistently oriented edge topology proves an anatomical foramen or excludes self-intersection. Motor root is not sensory V3. Specific ICA-vidian and meningo-lacrimal components remain unresolved.
